title: Array of arrays, including an empty inner array, at depth
rationale: Covers arrays-of-arrays and the empty-array-at-depth case in one document and separates the two sides of the library cleanly: the flatten side is faithful (extractFieldsPreservingStructure records the empty inner list positionally) while the reconstruct side throws the structure away.
catchesBugClass: Loss of one level of array nesting, and regression of the empty-inner-list bugfix in extractFieldsPreservingStructure. Because flatten is correct here, asserting the intermediate localises the defect to JsonReconstructor.
cannotCatch: It cannot exercise deeper recursion in extractFieldsPreservingStructure - only two levels of array here - so a bug that appears at [[[1]]] is out of scope. It also cannot distinguish an empty inner array from a one-element array of null once reconstruction is involved.

predicted.detail: Flattening is correct via the _value sentinel. On reconstruct, prefix grid is flagged and the outer object is turned into an array of objects, transposing one nesting level away.
